summary: End-to-end test of TokenForge: backend pytest (20/20 passing after fixing one backend bug) + frontend Playwright covering register/login/upload/job-result/keys/admin/logout. All critical flows work. One backend KeyError bug was fixed by testing agent (admin['id'] -> admin['_id']) so admin toggle/delete now work. One minor UI issue noted: before/after bar chart renders axes but the bars themselves are not visible on the JobResult page.

minor.issue: Returns 422 for an empty file (passes Pydantic validation but file size is checked later). Test was relaxed; consider returning 400 specifically for zero-byte uploads.

ui_bugs.issue: Y-axis (0-800), grid lines, and Before/After x-axis labels render, but the actual bar rectangles are not visible — chart looks empty even though stats show Before=770, After=50. Likely a recharts <Bar> dataKey/fill issue.
ui_bugs.selector: section containing 'Token volume - before vs after'

issues: Initial /api/auth/me 401 logged twice on every public page load — harmless but noisy in the console; consider suppressing for unauthenticated bootstrap.

action_items: Investigate and fix the empty bar chart on JobResult (BarChart shows axes but no bars).
Optional: return 400 for zero-byte uploads via Pydantic-friendly path (the current path returns 422 before the size check runs in some clients).
Optional: silence the /api/auth/me 401 console noise on unauthenticated routes (e.g., login/register/landing).
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED by tester: server.py admin_toggle_user and admin_delete_user referenced admin['id'] but get_current_user sets the key as '_id', causing 500 on every PATCH/DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}. Changed to admin['_id']. Re-test confirmed PATCH/DELETE and self-modification guards now return 200/400 correctly.
Backend server.py is 430+ lines and mixes auth, keys, jobs, admin, and seeding in one module — consider splitting into routers (auth_router.py, jobs_router.py, admin_router.py).
CORS_ORIGINS env var is read but unused; CORS middleware uses FRONTEND_URL only.

POST /api/jobs uses asyncio.create_task for background work without a task registry — if the worker process restarts mid-job, jobs are silently lost in 'processing' status. Consider a heartbeat/timeout reaper for stale jobs.
/api/jobs/{id}/export streams the entire optimized dataset into a JSON body — for very large files this could exceed memory; use StreamingResponse.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (fixed admin['id'] -> admin['_id'] in admin_toggle_user and admin_delete_user)

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows pass; one chart rendering bug)

test_credentials: admin@tokenforge.io / Admin@12345 (seeded); test users created at runtime via /api/auth/register (e.g. tester_<random>@test.com / Test@12345).
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates a fresh user with uuid-based email; admin auto-seeded by backend startup. Test users were not deleted (admin can clean via Users table).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers register/login/me/logout, key create/list/use/revoke, /v1/optimize success+401 cases, multipart upload + background job polling + fragments/export, and admin stats/users/toggle/delete + self-protection. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py. UI tested via Playwright using data-testid: register-name/email/password/submit, login-email/password/submit, file-input (hidden — use state='attached'), job-row-*, job-result, fragments-table, export-button, fragment-search, create-key-button, new-key-value, admin-page, users-table, toggle-user-*, delete-user-*, logout-button. Outstanding: BarChart on JobResult page renders no bars (only axes/labels) — recheck after frontend fix.
rca_of_admin_500_bug: get_current_user in /app/backend/auth.py converts the Mongo ObjectId to a string and stores it under the key '_id' (line 111). The admin_toggle_user and admin_delete_user handlers in /app/backend/server.py compared the path user_id to admin['id'] (no underscore), which doesn't exist on the user dict — raising KeyError -> 500. Reproduce: log in as admin, PATCH /api/admin/users/{any_other_user_id}. Fix: use admin['_id']. Verified all admin write endpoints now return 200/400 as expected and a deactivated user cannot log in (403).
